changes.change: Moved the complete gift-box builder immediately after hero/ribbon without changing its mechanics.
Replaced the finite ribbon content with two identical groups.
Scroll moves exactly one group width, recalculated on refresh; min group width exceeds the visible band.
Removed link arrows from all flavour toggles; active state uses colour and an underline.
Implemented bounded inner-face magnet; fixed outer anchor, pointer/focus response, coarse/reduced disable.
Restricted the local SVG cursor to non-text art zones; ordinary cursors retained elsewhere.
Implemented select-only combobox with independent pending and committed selection, full keyboard navigation and reset.
Fits the option popup to the viewport, opening upwards when needed.
Removed all manual motion preference/state; only prefers-reduced-motion governs animation.
Added plain-text Spoki Studio footer credit and removed visible imagery disclaimers.
Replaced technical input instructions with the goal-oriented remove/replace action.
Preserved initially disabled submit/no-JavaScript phone fallback and honest demo behavior.
